transcript.text: Hi, the light in my Neff oven has stopped working (model B1ACE4HN0B). Oven works fine otherwise. Can I change the bulb myself and what bulb do I need?

Yes, an oven bulb is usually a job you can do yourself, as long as the oven is switched off at the wall isolator and completely cool first. The exact bulb depends on your model, so check the markings on the old bulb or your Neff manual, and only use a heat-resistant bulb made for ovens, not an ordinary household one. From what you have described, the most likely cause is oven lamp / bulb. Does the oven otherwise work normally and only the interior light has failed?
Yes, the oven heats fine, fan and display work too, it's only the interior light. No error codes. It stopped suddenly last week.
Could you tell me a bit more about what it is doing, and when it happens?

The light doesn't come on at all, whichever function I pick or when I open the door. Everything else works normally and there are no sounds or smells. I'll isolate it at the cooker switch and let it cool before I touch anything. What should I check next?
From what you have checked, this needs an appliance engineer to look at it: the next steps are beyond the checks that are safe to do yourself.
